'''Koensayr Manufacturing''', also known as '''Koensayr Corporation''', was a major manufacturer of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components; nearly one-fifth of all starships in operation had at least one component from the company. They are well known, especially for their excellent [[Engine/Legends|engine]], weapon, [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]], and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] designs. Parts sales made up nearly 72 percent of the company's profits.<ref name=":0">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Koensayr also produced a small number of its own vehicles, most notably the venerable [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]], the [[Sigma-class shuttle|''Sigma''-class shuttle]], and the [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter|K-wing bomber]]. It also developed a personal [[starskiff]] prior to the [[Swarm War]].<ref name=":0" />

[[Talon Karrde]] once used a delivery of Koensayr [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] as an excuse to slip into the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] just before the [[Raid on Bilbringi|raid]] there.
